Pons benchmark files (`sequence score` per line, 1-based columns).

Source: <http://blog.gamesolver.org/solving-connect-four/02-test-protocol/>,
6000 positions, 1000 per file.

| File | Official name | Set |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `end_easy` | `Test_L3_R1` | End-Easy |
| `middle_easy` | `Test_L2_R1` | Middle-Easy |
| `middle_medium` | `Test_L2_R2` | Middle-Medium |
| `begin_easy` | `Test_L1_R1` | Begin-Easy |
| `begin_medium` | `Test_L1_R2` | Begin-Medium |
| `begin_hard` | `Test_L1_R3` | Begin-Hard |

`openings` is not part of that set. Longest move string first. A line that is only a score is the empty board.
